title: Purchases
intro: Bring stock in with purchase orders, receiving documents, and purchase returns to suppliers.

sections.title: Purchase orders
steps: Create a PO against a supplier with expected lines and quantities.
Submit and approve according to your role before receiving goods.
sections.caption: Purchase orders list.

sections.title: Purchases (receiving)
sections.intro: Purchases post stock into a location and update average cost.
steps: Record the supplier invoice and received lines.
Link to a purchase order when one exists, then save to update inventory.
sections.caption: Purchases list.

sections.title: Purchase returns
steps: Return damaged or incorrect goods to the supplier.
Saving a return reduces on-hand quantity at the location.
sections.caption: Purchase returns tab.
